nameForms.name: King of Alba
nameForms.note: Early Gaelic kingdom of the Picts and Scots.
nameForms.noteCn: 皮克特人与苏格兰人的早期盖尔王国。

nameForms.name: King of Scots
nameForms.note: Style that became fixed in the later kingdom.

holders.note: Became king as the Alpin dynasty established control over Alba.
holders.noteCn: 阿尔平王朝确立对阿尔巴的统治后即位。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Kenneth I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄肯尼思一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his uncle Donald I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其叔唐纳德一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Constantine I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄康斯坦丁一世。

holders.note: Held the kingship jointly with Giric amid a disputed succession.
holders.noteCn: 在继承争议中与吉里克共同掌握王权。

holders.note: Claimed the kingship alongside Eochaid amid a disputed succession.
holders.noteCn: 在继承争议中与埃奥凯德并立为王。

holders.note: Succeeded Giric.
holders.noteCn: 继承吉里克。

holders.note: Succeeded his cousin Donald II.
holders.noteCn: 继承其堂兄弟唐纳德二世。

holders.note: Succeeded Constantine II.
holders.noteCn: 继承康斯坦丁二世。

holders.note: Succeeded Malcolm I.
holders.noteCn: 继承马尔科姆一世。

holders.note: Succeeded Indulf.
holders.noteCn: 继承因达尔夫。

holders.note: Succeeded Dub.
holders.noteCn: 继承杜布。

holders.note: Claimed the kingship amid a succession dispute with Amlaíb.
holders.noteCn: 在与阿姆莱布的继承争议中主张王位。

holders.note: Claimed the kingship alongside Kenneth II amid a succession dispute.
holders.noteCn: 在继承争议中与肯尼思二世并立为王。

holders.note: Succeeded Kenneth II.
holders.noteCn: 继承肯尼思二世。

holders.note: Succeeded Constantine III.
holders.noteCn: 继承康斯坦丁三世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Kenneth III.
holders.noteCn: 继承父亲肯尼思三世。

holders.note: Succeeded his grandfather Malcolm II.
holders.noteCn: 继承外祖父马尔科姆二世。

holders.note: Seized the throne after killing Duncan I.
holders.noteCn: 杀死邓肯一世后夺取王位。

holders.note: Succeeded his stepfather Macbeth amid a struggle for the throne.
holders.noteCn: 在王位争夺中继承继父麦克白。

holders.note: Claimed the throne after defeating Lulach and restored the Dunkeld line.
holders.noteCn: 击败卢拉赫后夺取王位，恢复邓凯尔德世系。

holders.note: Succeeded Malcolm III amid a succession dispute.
holders.noteCn: 在继承争议中继承马尔科姆三世。

holders.note: Claimed the throne against Donald III with English support.
holders.noteCn: 在英格兰支持下对抗唐纳德三世，主张王位。

holders.note: Returned to the throne after Duncan II's death.
holders.noteCn: 邓肯二世去世后复位。

holders.note: Succeeded Donald III with English support.
holders.noteCn: 在英格兰支持下继承唐纳德三世。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Edgar.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄埃德加。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Alexander I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄亚历山大一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his grandfather David I as a child.
holders.noteCn: 幼年继承其祖父大卫一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Malcolm IV.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄马尔科姆四世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father William I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父威廉一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Alexander II.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父亚历山大二世。

holders.note: After Alexander III's death, competing claims left the Scottish throne unsettled until the Great Cause.
holders.noteCn: 亚历山大三世去世后，多方争位，苏格兰王位直到大诉讼前一直悬而未决。

holders.note: Chosen in the Great Cause under Edward I.
holders.noteCn: 在英王爱德华一世主持的大诉讼中被选为国王。

holders.note: After John Balliol's deposition, Scotland was governed under Edward I's overlordship until Robert the Bruce claimed the throne.
holders.noteCn: 约翰·巴里奥被废后，苏格兰在爱德华一世宗主权下由守护者治理，直到罗伯特·布鲁斯登基。

holders.note: Crowned at Scone and led the fight for independence.
holders.noteCn: 在斯昆加冕并领导独立斗争。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Robert the Bruce as a child.
holders.noteCn: 幼年继承其父罗伯特·布鲁斯。

holders.note: First Stewart king, succeeding his uncle David II.
holders.noteCn: 首任斯图亚特国王，继承其舅大卫二世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Robert II.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父罗贝尔二世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Robert III; long captive in England.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父罗贝尔三世，长期被囚于英格兰。

holders.note: Succeeded his father James I as a child.
holders.noteCn: 幼年继承其父詹姆斯一世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father James II as a child.
holders.noteCn: 幼年继承其父詹姆斯二世。

holders.note: Succeeded his father James III after Sauchieburn.
holders.noteCn: 索奇伯恩之战后继承其父詹姆斯三世。
